title: SPA/137/2012 of ARVIND KUMAR Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Special Appeal No. 137 of 2012
Arvind Kumar ......Appellant.
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and others. ......Respondents
Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. Vinay Kumar, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / respondents.
Coram: Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C.J.
 Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.
BARIN GHOSH, C.J. (ORAL)
 We are not inclined to admit the appeal, inasmuch as,
the fact remains that the appellant, while doing his graduation,
neither had Physics, nor Chemistry, nor Botany, nor Geology and nor
Mathematics. Appellant did BCA. It has been certified by the
University, fromwhere the appellant obtained BCA degree, that BCA
degree comes under Science stream too. The fact remains that the
advertisement was for Special BTC training in Science group. There
is no dispute that there is a departmental Circular dated 13th April,
2005, which contemplates that Science stream would include those
candidates, who have done their graduation in at least two subjects
out of Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Geology and Mathematics.
2. In those circumstances, rejection of the candidature of
the appellant cannot be interfered with. In the event, BTC training
for computer teachers is contemplated, an appropriate advertisement
to that effect will be issued.
3. The appeal fails and the same is dismissed.
(U.C. Dhyani, J.) (Barin Ghosh, C.J.)
 14.06.2012 14.6.2012
Rathour
